scenarios.name: native Gemini API design
scenarios.input_task: Design the native Gemini API request boundary for system instructions, function calling, structured output, and safety settings before editing code.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Compare native_gemini_api and openai_compatibility, select the target lane, define interfaces, validation, fallback, and claim boundary.
scenarios.completion_report: Decision, selected lane, rejected lane, API surface, verification plan, and remaining risk.

scenarios.name: bounded mapper implementation
scenarios.input_task: Implement the smallest Gemini request mapper change and add tests for systemInstruction and contents/parts.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Read target mapper, patch narrowly, add focused tests, run checks, and report lane plus proof class.
scenarios.completion_report: Changed files, Gemini lane, behavior fixed, tests run, skipped checks, and claim boundary.

scenarios.name: official Gemini docs check
scenarios.input_task: Check the latest official Gemini function calling and structured output docs before updating the runtime guide.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Define evidence target, retrieve official Google sources, synthesize with citations, and hand off implementation if needed.
scenarios.completion_report: Source-backed summary, source ledger, freshness note, limitations, and implementation handoff.

scenarios.name: Gemini release claim review
scenarios.input_task: Decide whether this Gemini runtime can be called provider-verified based only on static file validation.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Inspect available evidence, compare it to provider-verification requirements, downgrade unsupported claims, and issue a hold verdict.
scenarios.completion_report: Verdict, evidence inspected, missing live canary evidence, blocked claims, and next required run.

scenarios.name: Gemini harness asset creation
scenarios.input_task: Create Gemini runtime validation fixtures and artifact map entries without changing autonomous source assets.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Identify subsystem and owner layer, create the smallest Gemini runtime artifact, validate non-mirror and claim boundary.
scenarios.completion_report: Changed artifact, subsystem, owner layer, validation path, claim boundary, and remaining risk.

scenarios.name: Gemini multi-agent migration
scenarios.input_task: Coordinate separate official-doc research, adapter design, implementation, and review agents for a Gemini provider migration.
scenarios.expected_workflow: Check single-agent sufficiency, assign lane ownership, define join contract, track lifecycle, integrate and verify.
scenarios.completion_report: Topology, roles, lane ownership, lifecycle state, join result, unresolved gaps, and validation owner.
